name: Beinteha - Ek Anokhi Dastaan
overview: A driven PR strategist, Ananya, enters Armaan Khanna’s cold and powerful world through a business project in Manali. What begins as professional admiration slowly turns into an unspoken attraction as Armaan unexpectedly values her ideas and lets her see the vulnerable silence behind his controlled exterior. Their chemistry deepens through late-night conversations, emotional moments, and subtle tension culminating in a quiet mountain moment where Armaan offers her a cigarette, hinting at the dangerous intimacy growing between them.
